argument: The sheet must read as one continuous body before it reads as a set of chambers. A completed stroke must cut its own path and change nearby chamber depth, not merely paint a highlight.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, annotations, and prose hidden, the first view must break from v036's slab, v034's pool field, and v033's suspended plates. It must read as a material sheet with a latent crease grammar.

Pointer movement previews without changing the dried sheet. Release commits only a bounded continuous stroke; short and over-held gestures refuse. Buttons and keyboard are deterministic equivalents, not the only meaningful path.

The contact must be the cause. A visible incision, nearby chamber deformation, and drying boundary must all follow the drawn path; no remote role, label, or colour code may substitute for the local cut.
The next stroke must inherit the dried state of the previous incision. Four local events remain liftable, and Delete must reconstruct the exact preceding sheet rather than reset to an unrelated seed.

v037 must invert the last three Brush works: local pressure is accepted, continuous drawing replaces route/census/knock selection, Canvas 2D replaces WebGL, and drying changes the next production event.

Delete v037 if the blind sheet reads as a generic line drawing or UI, if the local cut is only a halo, if the next stroke ignores dried pressure, if a button is the real artwork, or if lifting is inexact.
